_what_this_is: Every model considered for the v0 pin, with the fields the screen needs, taken from each repository's own config.json and file listing rather than from a paper. `fetched_utc` and `revision` say exactly what was read; re-running `eval/screen.py --refresh` re-reads them and fails loudly if a field moved, because a config that changed under a pinned benchmark is a silent change to the oracle.
_access_note: `gated` is from the HuggingFace model API. A gated repository is not redistributable-by-default even under a permissive licence: a stranger cloning this repo cannot fetch the weights without an account and a click-through. That is a screen failure, not a footnote -- the benchmark has to be re-runnable by strangers.

pixart-sigma-xl2-1024.license_note: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M. Redistributable and re-runnable without credentials; carries use restrictions (Attachment A) that a benchmark harness does not trip. The T5-XXL encoder weights are google/t5-v1_1-xxl, Apache-2.0, ungated.

denoiser._norm_note: ada_norm_single: ONE shared 6-way modulation table plus a per-layer learned offset, so the AdaLN projection is not per-layer-per-token. That is the shape the `fused AdaLN` backlog item targets.

flux1-schnell.license_note: Apache-2.0 WEIGHTS behind an auto-approved HuggingFace gate. `curl` returns 401 without a token. Permissive licence, non-permissive distribution -- and the gate is the binding constraint for a benchmark strangers must re-run.
flux1-schnell._screen_outcome: Ruled out on ACCESS, not on arithmetic. Its arithmetic is good and it is the obvious next MODEL to open a generation around, once the gating is resolved. Not named by generation number here: numbers are allocated as generations are created and BG-2 is already a 512px PixArt generation.

qwen-image._screen_outcome: Apache-2.0 and ungated, and 20B of DiT at bf16 is 40 GB against 32. Ruled out for v0 on FIT; it is the natural target for the offload/streaming cells once those exist.

denoiser._attention_note: Self-attention at 64x64 (4096 tokens) and 32x32 (1024). No attention at 128x128.

sdxl-base-1.0._screen_outcome: Ungated, redistributable, and the MLPerf Inference image-generation workload, so a stranger has a second opinion on every number. Ruled out for v0 on REGENERATION and REACH: it is a UNet, so the DiT-attention, AdaLN and per-resolution-shape cells that make up most of the backlog have no home in it, and its 817M text encoder makes the text-encoder cells uninteresting.

denoiser._note: DC-AE at f32, so a 1024px image is a 32x32 latent and patch_size 1 gives 1024 tokens.

sana-1.6b-1024._screen_outcome: Ruled out on RESOLUTION-of-surface and on LICENCE REACH: linear attention at 1024 tokens is a quarter of the token count the backlog is written against, so the headline DiT-attention cells shrink to nothing, and the Gemma-2 text encoder carries Google's Gemma Terms rather than the repo's Apache-2.0 -- a stranger re-running the benchmark inherits a second licence.
